symptom: Cloud Git and gh work once, then fail with ECONNREFUSED while the worker remains alive: the shared socket pathname points at a different inode. Native listener close also unlinks foreign replacements at its original bind path.
rule: Use an instance-specific socket outside persisted state, publish it to every child, and remove only owned inodes, including native close behavior. Join concurrent starts and disposal; retry only a pre-delivery missing or refused connection within the original deadline. Principles 1, 6, 7, 10, 13 and 17.
